text: On my return downstairs, I felt that Mrs. Jellyby looked down upon me rather for being so frivolous, and I was sorry for it, though at the same time I knew that I had no higher pretensions. It was nearly midnight before we found an opportunity of going to bed, and even then we left Mrs. Jellyby among her papers drinking coffee and Miss Jellyby biting the feather of her pen. “What a strange house!” said Ada when we got upstairs. “How curious of my cousin Jarndyce to send us here!” “My love,” said I, “it quite confuses me. I want to understand it, and I can’t understand it at all.” “What?” asked Ada with her pretty smile.
